# SBG V2 — Repository Map

**Generated by:** Agent O (Architecture & Cleanup Audit)  
**Date:** 2025-07-07  
**Scope:** Full repository map documenting directory purposes, entry points, pipeline, and artifact contents.

---

## 1. Top-Level Directory Structure

```
SBG/
├── README.md                    # Project overview, key findings, reproduction guide
├── benchmark/                   # Phase 1: benchmark corpus and dataset generation
├── sbg/                         # Phase 2: SBG extraction engine (v1 + v2)
├── baselines/                   # Phase 3 + V2: baseline implementations
├── experiments/                 # Phase 4 + V2: experiment scripts
├── phase5/                      # Phase 5: cross-language and regression evaluation
├── phase6/                      # Phase 6: adversarial review
├── phase7/                      # Phase 7: final artifact generation
├── docs/                        # Research documentation and design specs
└── artifacts/                   # All generated outputs (results, gates, manifests)
```

---

## 2. Directory Purposes

### `benchmark/`
The benchmark corpus for semantic-equivalence detection experiments.

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `benchmark/corpus/base_programs/` | 64 canonical Python programs across 12 algorithmic categories |
| `benchmark/corpus/programs_manifest.json` | Program metadata (category, function signatures) |
| `benchmark/datasets/pairs_{split}.jsonl` | Train/dev/val/test pair records (3,577 total pairs) |
| `benchmark/datasets/variants/{split}/` | Generated SP and SC variant .py files |
| `benchmark/datasets/generation_summary.json` | Statistics from benchmark generation run |
| `benchmark/ground_truth/validator.py` | Differential testing ground-truth validator |
| `benchmark/splits/` | Split assignment files and validation reports |
| `benchmark/transformations/preserving/` | SP-1 through SP-12 transformation implementations |
| `benchmark/transformations/mutations/` | SC-1 through SC-14 mutation implementations |
| `benchmark/scripts/generate_benchmark.py` | **Entry point:** generate all pairs from corpus |
| `benchmark/scripts/validate_benchmark.py` | **Entry point:** validate generated pairs |
| `benchmark/scripts/leakage_audit.py` | Leakage check across splits |
| `benchmark/scripts/assign_splits.py` | Split assignment logic (seed=42) |
| `benchmark/scripts/diversity_audit.py` | Corpus diversity analysis |
| `benchmark/scripts/power_analysis.py` | Statistical power analysis (n=744 test pairs) |

### `sbg/`
The SBG extraction and distance engine. **V1 is frozen; V2 extends via `sbg/v2/`.**

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `sbg/canonicalization.py` | GENOME_REGISTRY; canonical form for each dimension |
| `sbg/distance.py` | `behavioral_distance(G1, G2) → [0,1]`; 8-dimension weighted combination |
| `sbg/serialization.py` | GenomeBundle JSON serialization; ProvenanceTracker |
| `sbg/cli.py` | CLI entry point for single-program genome extraction |
| `sbg/extraction/static/extractor.py` | Unified static extractor (CONTROL + DATA + ERROR) |
| `sbg/extraction/static/data_genome.py` | DATA dimension: variable types, assignment patterns, data flow |
| `sbg/extraction/static/error_genome.py` | ERROR dimension: exception handling patterns |
| `sbg/extraction/dynamic/tracer.py` | Dynamic tracer (runtime call/coverage collection) |
| `sbg/extraction/dynamic/state_genome.py` | STATE dimension |
| `sbg/extraction/dynamic/resource_genome.py` | RESOURCE dimension |
| `sbg/extraction/dynamic/temporal_genome.py` | TEMPORAL dimension |
| `sbg/extraction/dynamic/interaction_genome.py` | INTERACTION dimension |
| `sbg/v2/execution/runner.py` | SandboxRunner: composes v1 Tracer with noise-floor measurement |
| `sbg/v2/execution/normalizer.py` | TraceNormalizer: anonymization and rename-invariant normalization |
| `sbg/v2/execution/genome.py` | DynamicGenome + DynamicGenomeExtractor + `distance()` |
| `sbg/v2/hybrid/fusion.py` | HybridGenome fusion + `hybrid_distance()` (pre-registered weights) |
| `sbg/v2/hybrid/distance.py` | Alias / additional hybrid distance utilities |
| `sbg/v2/execution/tests/` | V2 engine test suite (19 tests, all pass at PHASE_2_GATE) |
| `sbg/test_distance.py` | V1 unit tests for `behavioral_distance()` |
| `sbg/test_serialization.py` | V1 unit tests for GenomeBundle serialization |

### `baselines/`
Phase 3 baseline implementations (B01–B08, V1) and V2 baselines (B07-v2, B08-v2).

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `baselines/b01_token.py` | B01: Token TF-IDF cosine similarity |
| `baselines/b02_ast.py` | B02: Normalized AST edit-distance similarity |
| `baselines/b03_cfg.py` | B03: Static CFG structure similarity |
| `baselines/b04_dependency.py` | B04: Use-def dependency approximation |
| `baselines/b05_embedding.py` | B05: Subword n-gram TF-IDF fallback (CodeBERT unavailable) |
| `baselines/b06_dynamic.py` | B06: V1 flat dynamic trace features |
| `baselines/b07_static_sbg.py` | B07: Static-only SBG (CONTROL+DATA+ERROR) |
| `baselines/b08_full_sbg.py` | B08: Full 8-dimension SBG (primary system) |
| `baselines/common.py` | Shared utilities: `load_pairs`, `compute_metrics`, `compute_auroc` |
| `baselines/run_all_baselines.py` | **Entry point:** run all Phase 3 baselines end-to-end |
| `baselines/v2/b07_dynamic_v2.py` | **B07-v2:** Dynamic-only SBG v2 (tests H7, H9) |
| `baselines/v2/b08_hybrid_sbg_v2.py` | **B08-v2:** Hybrid static+dynamic SBG v2 (tests H8, H9) |

## 3. Entry Points for Each Experiment

### Phase 1 — Benchmark Generation
```bash
python3 benchmark/scripts/generate_benchmark.py          # generate all pairs
python3 benchmark/scripts/validate_benchmark.py          # validate 0 issues
python3 benchmark/scripts/leakage_audit.py               # confirm 0 leakage
```

### Phase 3 — Baselines (V1)
```bash
python3 baselines/run_all_baselines.py                   # run B01–B08
# Individual baselines:
python3 baselines/b01_token.py
python3 baselines/b02_ast.py
python3 baselines/b08_full_sbg.py
# (etc. for B03–B07)
```

### Phase 4 — Experiments (V1)
```bash
# Individual experiments:
python3 experiments/phase4/e1_equivalence_detection.py
python3 experiments/phase4/e2_mutation_detection.py
python3 experiments/phase4/e3_invariance.py
python3 experiments/phase4/e6_baseline_comparison.py
python3 experiments/phase4/e7_ablation.py
python3 experiments/phase4/e12_runtime_cost.py
# Full Phase 4 gate:
python3 experiments/phase4/run_phase4_gate.py
```

### Phase 5 — Cross-Language & Regression
```bash
python3 phase5/cross_language/generate_corpus.py
python3 phase5/cross_language/evaluate_cross_language.py
python3 phase5/regression/evaluate_regression.py
```

### Phase 6 — Adversarial Review
```bash
python3 phase6/adversarial_review.py
```

### Phase 7 — Final Artifacts
```bash
python3 phase7/generate_final_artifacts.py
```

### V2 Baselines
```bash
python3 baselines/v2/b07_dynamic_v2.py                  # Dynamic-only (H7, H9)
python3 baselines/v2/b08_hybrid_sbg_v2.py               # Hybrid (H8, H9)
```

### V2 Statistical Analysis
```bash
python3 experiments/v2/e1_statistical_analysis.py        # (requires B07, B08 artifacts)
```

---

## 4. How to Run the Full Pipeline

```bash
# Prerequisites: Python >= 3.9, stdlib only (no pip install required)

# Step 1: Regenerate benchmark pairs from corpus
python3 benchmark/scripts/generate_benchmark.py
python3 benchmark/scripts/validate_benchmark.py

# Step 2: Run all Phase 3 baselines (B01–B08)
python3 baselines/run_all_baselines.py

# Step 3: Run all Phase 4 experiments (E1–E12)
python3 experiments/phase4/run_phase4_gate.py

# Step 4: Run Phase 5 (cross-language + regression)
python3 phase5/cross_language/generate_corpus.py
python3 phase5/cross_language/evaluate_cross_language.py
python3 phase5/regression/evaluate_regression.py

# Step 5: Run V2 baselines
python3 baselines/v2/b07_dynamic_v2.py
python3 baselines/v2/b08_hybrid_sbg_v2.py

# Step 6: V2 statistical analysis
python3 experiments/v2/e1_statistical_analysis.py

# Step 7: Run test suite
python3 -m pytest sbg/ benchmark/ground_truth/ -v

# Step 8: Generate final artifacts
python3 phase7/generate_final_artifacts.py
```

All results are deterministic with `SEED=42`. Expected total runtime: ~30–60 minutes on modern hardware (dominant cost: benchmark generation and dynamic tracing).

## 5. Artifact Contents

### `artifacts/final/` — Release Artifacts
| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `FINAL_BENCHMARK_MANIFEST.json` | Benchmark statistics (64 programs, 3,577 pairs, diversity=0.852, leakage=CLEAN) |
| `FINAL_STATISTICAL_RESULTS.json` | Full hypothesis verdicts H1–H6, AUROC results, statistical protocol |
| `FINAL_CLAIMS_AUDIT.json` | 15 claims × status (SUPPORTED/NOT_SUPPORTED/NOT_EVALUABLE) |
| `FINAL_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json` | SHA-256 hashes of all key artifacts + presence check |
| `FINAL_REPRODUCIBILITY_MANIFEST.json` | Reproduction steps, seeds, known limitations |

### `artifacts/v2/` — V2 Experimental Artifacts
| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json` | SAFEGUARD-1 attestation: H7–H12 committed before execution |
| `PHASE_0_GATE.json` | V2 Phase 0 audit results (CONDITIONAL_PASS) |
| `PHASE_2_GATE.json` | V2 Phase 2 gate: H7 SUPPORTED (AUROC=0.531), H9 SUPPORTED (inversion resolved), H8 NOT_SUPPORTED |
| `E1_statistical_analysis.json` | Holm-Bonferroni analysis for H7/H8/H9 |
| `B07/results_dev.json`, `B07/results_test.json` | Dynamic-only baseline results |
| `B08/results_dev.json`, `B08/results_test.json` | Hybrid baseline results |

### `artifacts/research/` — Phase Gate Records
Phase gates PHASE_0 through PHASE_6, plus benchmark design, formal model, and hypothesis summaries.

### `artifacts/phase3/` — V1 Baseline Results
Per-baseline dev/test results for B01–B08. Also contains BASELINE_COMPARISON.json, FAIRNESS_AUDIT.json, LEAKAGE_AUDIT.json, STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS.json.

### `artifacts/phase4/` — V1 Experiment Results
Per-experiment results E1 through E12 (all complete).

### `artifacts/phase5/` — Phase 5 Results
`cross_language_results.json` and `regression_results.json`.
